properties.name: Addicks Estates
properties.note: ⚠ DATA GAP: Addicks Estates sits east of I-495 (enter via Myrtle Ave) with the Citisteel site, I-495, and the transit center as immediate neighbors. Its census block group stretches westward past Archmere Academy, past commercial areas on Philadelphia Pike, and into adjacent neighborhoods — masking the true burden on Addicks Estates residents. Should align more closely with Knollwood's block group or have its own. Real conditions likely worse than scores shown.
